name: mirage
text: Fixed: the engine restarted and reports 'Novig read-only key active: 16 reads a second, websocket on'. So the new key works and streaming is back. Keep that newest 'Vigilant cloud engine' key (made about 09:52 UTC). Older ones named 'Vigilant cloud engine' are now unused and safe to revoke in Novig later if you want a tidy list; leave your trading key and your phone's and tablet's keys alone. The first full scan on the key should finish in a few minutes instead of 11.
